texto: In Dutch forms and administrative documents, the information is usually labelled by concise fields: «voornaam» (first name), «achternaam» (family name), «geboortedatum» (date of birth), «adres» (address with street and number) and «postcode» (Dutch postal code, consisting of four digits and two capital letters, for example «3511 AB»).

opciones.explicacion: «Voornaam» is the personal first name, unlike the last name («achternaam»).
